subject: Intro + next steps: identifying budget steward & procurement cadence
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@novahealth.io>, Daniel Ruiz <daniel@novahealth.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + next steps: identifying budget steward & procurement cadence

Hi Asha / Daniel — thanks again for the demo today, really appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align the right stakeholders and keep momentum: 

Recap (from today)
- Walkthrough: We covered the latency / throughput profile for the inference path and the pilot scope (50k monthly inference requests, mixed chat + embeddings).
- Compliance note: You flagged SOC2 and retention requirements as gating items for procurement.
- Success metrics: 20% reduction in per-interaction cost and <120ms 95th pct latency in production.

Ask / immediate items
1) Who is the budget steward for this engagement (title + name)? In several orgs this is CFO/Head of Applied AI or a Platform owner — if you can confirm the single person who signs off on the spend that would be ideal.
2) Who should be the procurement contact for contract redlines and vendor onboarding? If procurement prefers a questionnaire, happy to have them send it.
3) Proposed timelines: pilot kickoff week of Apr 18 — does that align with your internal calendar?

Proposed mutual action plan (short):
- This week: you confirm budget steward and procurement contact.
- By Mar 29: Redwood sends SOW draft + demo recording + procurement answers.
- Apr 5–9: Procurement review / SOC2 proof exchange.
- Apr 18: Pilot kick-off (if procurement + budget approvals complete).

Attachments: I am attaching a short SOW draft and the recording we captured (12 min).

If easier, I can loop in a short 20-min meeting next week with procurement and your budget owner — propose Tue Mar 23 or Thu Mar 25 (10–11am PT).

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
(415) 555-0147

Thanks Karthik — great demo and useful summary. Quick answers below and attaching our standard procurement questionnaire.

Budget steward: Priya Shah (CFO) — priya.shah@novahealth.io. She owns any vendor spend above $50k annually.
Procurement contact: procurement@novahealth.io (you'll see Maria Ortega on their side; I put procurement on cc here).

Timing: Apr 18 pilot kickoff looks feasible but I need to confirm Priya's availability for a budget conversation during the week of Apr 5–9. If procurement wants to start review earlier, they can use the questionnaire I attached.

Next steps from our side: I will introduce Priya and Maria on a follow-up thread once I confirm Priya's calendar. Otherwise, Tue Mar 23 10am PT works for a quick alignment call with procurement if you prefer to start there.

Cheers,
Asha Menon
Head of Dev Platforms, NovaHealth
asha.menon@novahealth.io

Asha — perfect, thank you. Adding procurement on this thread. 

Maria / procurement team — hi, Karthik from Redwood here. Per Asha's note, attaching the SOW draft and our short answers doc (see Drive link below) to speed review. A few practical notes to help procurement triage: 
- Standard terms we see: data handling addendum + SOC2 report (we can provide certificate + controls summary).
- Pilot pricing: we typically run a 6-week pilot with a credit-backed invoice; flexible to structure a short POC if that helps.

If helpful I can send a redlined template for your legal to review — or we can take your procurement questionnaire and annotate it. Which do you prefer?

I'll hold Tue Mar 23 10am PT as an optional slot for a procurement intro. If that works, please confirm and I'll send a calendar invite.
